about: SCION-48 trace: per scene frame, the state the dog's own machine chose (state, sub) and what the board showed, measured from the rendered cells: x_screen/y_screen = centroid of the dog's discs (film pixels), x_world_measured = the centroid of its torso cells cast back onto the dog's path (score metres; the camera cuts at 24.625 s), facing = +1 when the head cells sit door-side of the body cells, posture from the height of the dog's cells. x_score is the machine's own position.
